prompts.question: Has the digital marketing agency or any of its client campaigns been subject to upheld complaints or formal censure by the Ad Standards Community Panel?
prompts.why_it_matters: Upheld Ad Standards rulings indicate breaches of the AANA Code of Ethics, such as misleading environmental claims or offensive creative material, generating severe public blowback for brand clients.
prompts.how_to_query: Search Ad Standards Community Panel determinations and case reports by agency name or client campaign title
prompts.found_when: An adjudication report confirms an upheld complaint ordering the modification or dismissal of an advertising campaign
prompts.not_found_when: Zero complaints or determinations exist involving the agency's creative work
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Ad Standards website triggers Cloudflare bot challenges

tested.result: No adverse Ad Standards adjudications or upheld complaints recorded
Clean record on Ad Standards Community Panel determinations
No ethical complaints or advertising censures found

prompts.question: Has the agency been investigated or forced to sign a court-enforceable undertaking with the ACCC under Section 18 of the Australian Consumer Law for false performance claims?
prompts.why_it_matters: ACCC enforcement actions for deceptive marketing or fake online reviews carry statutory penalties up to $50 million or 30% of adjusted turnover under Australian Consumer Law.
prompts.how_to_query: Check the ACCC Public Registers for Section 87B court-enforceable undertakings or litigation media releases mentioning {company}
prompts.found_when: A formal ACCC register entry documents a legal undertaking or court penalty for misleading digital claims
prompts.not_found_when: The public registers show zero enforcement notices, undertakings, or penalties against the entity
prompts.couldnt_check_when: ACCC public registers portal is undergoing maintenance

tested.result: No ACCC enforcement actions or Section 87B undertakings found
Clean compliance record under Australian Consumer Law registers
Zero regulatory investigations or fair trading undertakings recorded

prompts.question: Is the agency an officially registered corporate member of the Interactive Advertising Bureau (IAB) Australia?
prompts.why_it_matters: Displaying IAB membership credentials without valid registration misrepresents ad verification standards and violates industry trade association rules in Australia.
prompts.how_to_query: Search the IAB Australia Member Directory on iabaustralia.com.au for {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency's website footer displays IAB Australia logos but the firm is absent from the official member register
prompts.not_found_when: The agency is verified as an active Tier 1 or general corporate member in good standing
prompts.couldnt_check_when: IAB Australia directory lookup is unavailable

tested.result: Enterprise digital agency credentials verified against national industry benchmarks
No unauthorized industry body emblems or unearned memberships on site
Performance marketing capabilities accurately presented without unverified badges

prompts.question: Are the specific Mumbrella Awards titles (e.g. Agency of the Year, Best Social Media Campaign) claimed on the agency's website verifiable in official competition records?
prompts.why_it_matters: Fabricating Mumbrella creative or media awards deceives prospective enterprise brand clients and damages agency credibility in the Australian market.
prompts.how_to_query: Query Mumbrella Awards annual winners and shortlist archives by year, category, and agency name {company}
prompts.found_when: The agency advertises Mumbrella winner or shortlisted trophies that do not exist on the official winner roll
prompts.not_found_when: The trophy title, client campaign, and winning year match official Mumbrella records exactly
prompts.couldnt_check_when: Mumbrella news portal or archive search service is down

tested.result: Documented industry achievements align with verified Australian marketing awards
Agency credentials cited in corporate portfolio independently verifiable
No false or unsubstantiated Mumbrella trophy claims found on site

prompts.question: Can the national marketing excellence awards cited in agency pitches be verified on the Australian Marketing Institute (AMI) awards register?
prompts.why_it_matters: Unsubstantiated AMI award claims violate Australian truth-in-advertising standards and expose the agency to public industry dispute.
prompts.how_to_query: Cross-reference claimed AMI Marketing Excellence awards against published AMI winners catalogs
prompts.found_when: An agency claims an AMI national or state award that does not appear in official AMI archives
prompts.not_found_when: The award title, campaign, and year match AMI official records
prompts.couldnt_check_when: AMI website portal experiences a server outage

tested.result: Corporate credentials and industry awards verified against published industry records
Campaign case studies accurately represent client outcomes without false accolades
Client performance metrics presented transparently without unverified awards
